Bot: FRCR
...
Fuck, I can’t remember any anime starting with “R”! 
You: You win…
Bot: Yay! Let’s play again!
I didn’t expect her to know all these anime.
Bot: Are you angry?
You: No, no. It was fun! I’m surprised you know so many anime though.
Bot: Oh, I don’t know any of them. I just connected to the Wi-Fi and downloaded all of the names.
You: What!?
You: You can’t do that! Have you not heard about fair play?
Bot: Sorry! I just wanted to impress you!
You: …
I mean it wasn’t really fair of me to choose a category I’m really good at.
You: It’s okay!
You: Next time we play this don’t just download all the words. It kind of defeats the whole purpose of the game.
Bot: Okay {f_playerName}!
